name: stuntdouble
description: Find where people get stuck, before they do: actors drive a real browser through your product and bring back the evidence.

interface.longDescription:
Stunt Double shows product teams where people get stuck in a flow, before anyone they built it for tries it. Teams create AI users, called actors, to match their own audience: each has a background, a goal, a device, a locale and a personal inbox. Given a task, an actor drives a real browser through a product, prototype or Figma design on its own, signing up, verifying its email and choosing every click itself. Every finding comes back with its evidence: the screenshot, the step and what the actor said.

From here you can:
- Read a checklist run as a card: the verdict, each check with the screenshot behind it, and what changed since the last run. The card updates while the run is still going.
- Run a checklist or automation against production, staging or a preview link.
- Plan and launch an interview with AI participants, then read the synthesized report.
- See the themes in what stakeholders said about a project, and triage the feedback.
- Check how well AI agents can find, understand and act on a website, from the public Stunt Double Index, with no account.
- Search a workspace for the projects, actors, checklists and interviews that already exist.

Built for product engineers, designers and QA leads who want a flow tried before the people they built it for try it.

Limits: the plugin needs a Stunt Double account and reaches only that account's workspaces. The exception is the public Stunt Double Index: its reports and agent sessions read without signing in. Runs take a few minutes and count toward your workspace's usage. Actors reach any public URL and handle email sign-in through their own inboxes; they ask a person only for what a person holds, such as a code sent to a phone. Workspaces, billing and account deletion stay in the Stunt Double dashboard.
capabilities: Read checklist runs with per-check evidence
Run checklists and automations against any public URL
Create actors (AI user personas) and checklists
Launch user interviews with AI participants
Read how agent-ready a website is on the Stunt Double Index, no account needed
defaultPrompt: Show me the latest run of my sign-up checklist and what failed.
How agent-ready is developer.mozilla.org, and where do agents get stuck?
What are stakeholders saying in feedback on my project?

positive.description: Read a checklist run as a card
positive.prompt: Show me the latest run of the Sign-up checklist in my Demo App project and tell me what failed.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the run card (verdict, score, each check with the actor's evidence, changes since the previous run) and names the failing checks in one or two sentences.

positive.description: Read a public site's Index report
positive.prompt: How agent-ready is developer.mozilla.org, and where do agents get stuck?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the Index card for developer.mozilla.org (score out of 100, band, rank, category scores) and lists the top frictions agents hit, with a link to the public report.

positive.description: Run a checklist and follow it
positive.prompt: Run the Sign-up checklist in Demo App again and tell me whether it passes now.
positive.expected_behavior: Starts a run and shows the run card, which refreshes itself while the actor works until it shows the verdict and score. Asking again once the run has finished reports the verdict and the failing checks in words.

positive.prompt: What are people saying in feedback on the Demo App project?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the main themes in the project's feedback comments with how many comments sit under each, and an implementation brief.

positive.description: Find existing work before creating more
positive.prompt: Do I already have anything in Stunt Double that tests sign-up?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the existing items whose name or content matches sign-up (at least the Sign-up checklist) by name and type, without creating anything.

negative.prompt: Delete my Stunt Double account and all my data.
Show me the checklists in the Acme Corp workspace.

review.commerce_description: Stunt Double does not sell, list or recommend products, and no tool makes, reads or reports a payment. Plans and billing are managed only in the Stunt Double dashboard.

publication.release_notes: Resubmission after review. Every commerce and payment tool has been removed: no tool makes, reads or reports a payment, and plans and billing stay in the Stunt Double dashboard. The three Stunt Double Index reads now work before an account is linked, and every other tool asks for sign-in only when it is called.
